<thought>First, locate a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide from a primary amine and a sulfonyl chloride. Then, locate a template for a Heck coupling that joins an aryl bromide with an activated alkene (acrylamide). These two templates will allow a two‑step synthesis from the commercially available reagents p‑toluidine, 4‑bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, and N‑phenylacrylamide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(Br)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
